product.name: Tul Marketplace Platform
product.description: An online platform for registered commercial users to search, compare, and purchase construction materials in Latin America.

product.name: Tul Mobile Application
product.description: Mobile app available for iOS and Android devices enabling users to access Tul's marketplace and services on mobile platforms.

product.name: Payment Gateway System
product.description: A payment processing system integrated into Tul's platform to facilitate secure online payments for construction material orders.

product.name: Tul Credits
product.description: A credit balance system within Tul's platform that users can use for purchases, composed of refunds, credit notes, and promotional rewards.

product.name: Order Delivery and Pickup Service
product.description: Service managing the logistics of delivering purchased construction materials to specified addresses or allowing user pickup at Tul's warehouses.
